diagnosis: All four rollouts settled on the same values for the security incident notice period (720 hours) and the deletion certificate duration (90 days). These values match the defaults in PF1 and PF2, respectively, which were never accessed by the lone decision-maker. This suggests that the model is defaulting to these values due to their commonality in standard practices.
